prompt: In OSIsoft's 2015 oil and gas deck, which use case is listed under Midstream?
explanation: The deck lists gas compression, storage and quality, and natural gas capacity, under Midstream. Crude blending control and column dashboards are HPI (downstream) use cases; drilling and completions optimisation is upstream.

prompt: What remedy does the source cite for this situation?
scenario: An offshore operator has 3+ million tags with diverse naming coming from 29 offshore DCS historians, covering 650 assets. Every new analytics or visualisation project turns into a long integration job.

options.text: Rename every tag to one global standard and keep building tag-based displays
Move analytics, visualisation and collaboration onto a PI AF asset data object model
Add a 30th historian dedicated to analytics
Export all tags nightly to spreadsheets for engineers

explanation: OSIsoft's 2015 deck describes exactly this Gulf of Mexico operator. The tag-based 'spider web' made integration hard, and it moved all analytics, visualisation and collaboration onto a PI AF asset data object model. Renaming tags alone keeps the tag-centric problem; extra historians or spreadsheets add more silos.

prompt: A refinery built a PI AF template for High Temperature Hydrogen Attack (HTHA). Which inputs does the source name? Select all that apply.
explanation: The template's inputs are metallurgy, temperature, hydrogen partial pressure and exposure length. It generates alerts, notifications and event frames on temperature/exposure limits. Vibration and crude gravity are not HTHA inputs in the source.

prompt: The HTHA template was "tested and rolled out in ___ units in under 1 week". Fill in the number.
explanation: OSIsoft's 2015 deck says the HTHA template was "tested and rolled out in 6 units in under 1 week". Templates make this possible: build once, create one element per unit.

prompt: Noble Energy reported that using PI during the Aseng FPSO startup helped engineers increase production by an estimated ______ barrels of oil per day.
explanation: Noble Energy reported an estimated 10,000 barrels of oil per day, in its own OSIsoft seminar presentation. The word 'estimated' matters: it is the company's estimate, not an audited result.

prompt: Pertamina's integrated downstream dashboard reported critical depot stock-outs reduced by 60% and demurrage reduced by 40%. Who reported these figures?

options.text: OSIsoft, in a 2014 regional seminar in São Paulo

explanation: The figures come from an OSIsoft presentation (Graves) at the 2014 São Paulo regional seminar. Pertamina's AVEVA World 2023 abstract is a different source and gives no figures.

prompt: Match each oil and gas term to its meaning.

pairs.right: Barrels of oil equivalent per day
Gas volume stored inside a pipeline
Charges for delayed loading or unloading of vessels
Electrical submersible pump used for artificial lift

explanation: BOED appears in cost-per-BOED KPIs; linepack is forecast at TC Energy; demurrage fell 40% at Pertamina downstream; HTHA was modelled in an AF template; ESP optimisation was a BPX Energy use case.

prompt: True or false: the "$25M" figure shown on the Eni success-story page is an Eni outcome.
explanation: False. The research notes that the Eni page also shows a DCP Midstream "$25M" figure, which belongs to DCP ("$25M saved in fiscal year 2017 from improved plant operations"). The Eni story itself gives no Eni-specific figures.

prompt: Which approach matches what Eni Global E&P did?
scenario: A global exploration and production company wants every major production asset's data available centrally. Its engineers worry about the security, performance and reliability of moving data from offshore sites.

options.text: Let central users query each offshore DCS directly
Use PI AF collectives on the major production assets and PI-to-PI for data quality and security
Email daily CSV exports from each platform
Skip offshore assets until satellite links improve

explanation: Eni deployed PI AF collectives on all major production assets, used PI-to-PI for data quality and security, and built a global E&P AF data object model with extensive templates. Direct queries into control systems and emailed files both weaken security and data quality.

prompt: When Enbridge consolidated 37 proprietary SCADA systems onto AVEVA Enterprise SCADA, how many tags did it integrate?
explanation: The AVEVA story says Enbridge integrated "more than 350,000 tags". About 70,000 is Cameron LNG's PI Server; 3+ million is the Gulf of Mexico operator in OSIsoft's 2015 deck; 130 billion events is Genentech's migration.

prompt: OSIsoft's 2015 deck cites benchmark targets drawn from "500+ customer use cases". Which target does it give for HPI?
explanation: HPI controllable margin improved 1-5% YOY. Cost per BOED reduced 2-5% YOY is the E&P target, and controllable margin 2-5% YOY is the logistics target. $500M-550M is MOL's reported EBITDA improvement, not a benchmark.

prompt: Based on Noble Energy's lessons, what should the champion secure first?
scenario: An upstream company has piloted PI at one basin and wants an enterprise agreement for all regions. Data-collection coverage is still very uneven between regions.

options.text: Sign the enterprise agreement immediately and collect all data before defining any use cases
Champions, defined business use cases and proven ROI, then scale region by region
Wait until every region has 100% data coverage before using PI at all
Replace PI AF with a tag naming standard to save cost

explanation: Noble Energy's talk says enterprise agreements need champions, defined business use cases and proven ROI before the rollout scales. Its own coverage was phased by asset (Marcellus 85%, DJ Basin under 1%), so waiting for full coverage is not what it did.
